department: Civil and Environmental Engineering and Earth Sciences

deadline.value: Apply by December 15 to be considered for Internal Select Fellowships; the general fall deadline is January 1.
deadline.quote: Priority deadline to be considered for Internal Select Fellowships: December 15 | Fall application deadline: January 1

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is optional.
gre_general.quote: The GRE general test is optional.

funding.value: All incoming PhD students receive a stipend and tuition waiver.
funding.quote: All incoming students in our Ph.D. program and our research-based M.S. in Civil and Environmental Engineering and Earth Sciences program receive full financial support, which consists of a stipend and a tuition waiver.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required; apply with an undergraduate degree in engineering or the physical sciences.
entry_route.quote: A master’s degree is not required to pursue a Ph.D.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked.

notes: One department covers civil/environmental engineering, environmental fluid dynamics and earth sciences.
